concerns.text: The plan calls the external OpenAI `gpt‑3.5‑turbo` API (Phase 0 step 0.3). Principle I of the constitution requires full reproducibility on a fresh runner; reliance on a live LLM service can introduce nondeterministic changes over time even with temperature = 0. The plan should cache generated LLM outputs (or provide a deterministic seedable local model) and reference the cached artifacts, ensuring that re‑runs produce identical CodeSample entities.
